$schema.description: The gate-request format and the phax release that wrote this file: https://docs.phax.run/schemas/gate-request/<X.Y.Z>.json

base.description: The full object name of the commit the gated phase's branch was created from.

terminal.description: True exactly when the gated phase is the run's terminal phase.

files.description: The phase's planned files to create and to edit, deduplicated in plan order; optional files are excluded.

phases.description: Every phase of the run, in execution order, with its planned files.
